description: item/*: exact item from storage into a slot / dropped, kits, custom_data items, detection; give/clear parse (no players)

steps.run: data modify storage mcdp_lib:in item set value {id:"minecraft:diamond_sword",count:1,components:{"minecraft:unbreakable":{}}}
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.i] at @s run function mcdp_lib:item/set_slot_from_storage {slot:"armor.head"}

data modify storage mcdp_lib:config kits.t set value [{slot:"weapon.mainhand",item:"minecraft:iron_sword",count:1},{slot:"armor.feet",item:"minecraft:iron_boots",count:1},{item:"minecraft:bread",count:2}]
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.i] store success score #ok mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:item/kit {name:"none"}
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.i] store result score #r mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:item/has_custom {id:"wand",slots:"weapon.*"}
execute as @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=t.i] store result score #r mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:item/has_custom {id:"nope",slots:"weapon.*"}
execute store result score #r mcdp_lib_t run function mcdp_lib:item/give {targets:"@a",item:"minecraft:stick[minecraft:unbreakable={}]",count:2}
